title: Airwallex header
description: A sticky two-tier top: a pale lavender announcement strip with a dismiss cross, then an 80px white nav with a bold wordmark, four medium links, a teal language chip, a violet Log in, an outline demo button and a violet filled button. On phones the nav is 56px with a small filled button and a burger that drops a full-width panel.
notes: the whole header is position: sticky; put it first in the page
no JavaScript: the announcement closes through a hidden checkbox and the phone menu is a details disclosure
